title: Public service pensions remedy newsletter — July 2026
text:
This newsletter gives stakeholders the latest news on the public service pensions remedy.

 The newsletter has articles on: 

 • the public service pension schemes (rectification of unlawful discrimination) (tax) regulations 2026

 • extending the scheme pays election deadline

 • voluntary scheme pays deadline

 • making scheme pays elections through the ‘calculate your public service pension adjustment service‘

 • immediate detriment

 • armed forces pension scheme 75 members: new scheme benefits election

 • armed forces pension scheme 75 re-joiners: new scheme benefits election

 • changes to the tax treatment of trivial commutation lump sum death benefits (TCLSDBs)

 • changes to reporting deadlines following a member’s death

 • excess teacher service

 • transitional tax-free amount certificate (TTFAC)
